# STD-APP-CNT-001: Container Deployment

**Standards Metadata**

```yaml
standard_id: 'STD-APP-CNT-001'
standard_name: 'Container Deployment'
standard_type: 'application'
category: 'application'
version: '1.0.0'
status: 'active'
compliance_level: 'mandatory'
tags: ['application', 'container', 'deployment', 'docker', 'kubernetes', 'mandatory']
```

---

> This document defines comprehensive container deployment standards for enterprise applications, covering Docker image creation, Kubernetes deployment configurations, security practices, resource management, networking policies, monitoring integration, and CI/CD pipeline standards to ensure consistent, secure, and scalable container deployment practices across distributed systems.

[standards/application/container/STD-APP-CNT-001-container-deployment.md#10-overview]

## 1.0 Overview

This document establishes comprehensive standards for containerizing applications using Docker and deploying them on Kubernetes platforms. These standards ensure consistency, security, scalability, and operational excellence across all containerized applications in the enterprise.
page_texts.6:
[standards/application/container/STD-APP-CNT-001-container-deployment.md#21-container-security-requirements]

### 2.1 Container Security Requirements

All containerized applications must adhere to the following mandatory security requirements:

1. **Base Image Security**

    - Use only approved base images from trusted registries
    - Regularly scan images for vulnerabilities
    - Keep base images updated with latest security patches
    - Use minimal base images to reduce attack surface

2. **Runtime Security**

    - Run containers as non-root users
    - Implement proper resource limits and requests
    - Use read-only root filesystems where possible
    - Enable Pod Security Standards enforcement

3. **Network Security**
    - Implement network policies for traffic isolation
    - Use TLS for all service-to-service communication
    - Restrict ingress and egress traffic appropriately

[standards/application/container/STD-APP-CNT-001-container-deployment.md#multi-stage-dockerfile-template]

#### Multi-Stage Dockerfile Template

```dockerfile
# Build stage
FROM node:18-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production

COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# Production stage
FROM node:18-alpine AS runtime

# Install security updates
RUN apk update && apk upgrade

# Create non-root user
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S appgroup && \
    adduser -u 1001 -S appuser -G appgroup

WORKDIR /app

# Copy application files
COPY --from=builder --chown=appuser:appgroup /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=builder --chown=appuser:appgroup /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder --chown=appuser:appgroup /app/package.json ./

# Switch to non-root user
USER appuser

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
```

[standards/application/container/STD-APP-CNT-001-container-deployment.md#image-security-standards]

#### Image Security Standards

```dockerfile
# Security best practices example
FROM python:3.11-slim as builder

# Install security updates
RUN apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Create non-root user
RUN groupadd -r appuser && useradd -r -g appuser appuser

WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --user -r requirements.txt

# Production stage
FROM python:3.11-slim

# Install security updates only
RUN apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Create non-root user
RUN groupadd -r appuser && useradd -r -g appuser appuser

WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /root/.local /home/appuser/.local
COPY --chown=appuser:appuser . .

# Security configurations
USER appuser
EXPOSE 8000

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD python health_check.py

CMD ["python", "-m", "uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
```

[standards/application/container/STD-APP-CNT-001-container-deployment.md#standard-deployment-configuration]

#### Standard Deployment Configuration

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
    name: example-app
    labels:
        app: example-app
        version: v1.0.0
        environment: production
spec:
    replicas: 3
    strategy:
        type: RollingUpdate
        rollingUpdate:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 1
    selector:
        matchLabels:
            app: example-app
    template:
        metadata:
            labels:
                app: example-app
                version: v1.0.0
        spec:
            serviceAccountName: example-app-sa
            securityContext:
                runAsNonRoot: true
                runAsUser: 1001
                fsGroup: 1001
            containers:
                - name: app
                  image: your-registry/example-app:v1.0.0
                  ports:
                      - containerPort: 8080
                        name: http
                  env:
                      - name: DATABASE_URL
                        valueFrom:
                            secretKeyRef:
                                name: app-secrets
                                key: database-url
                  resources:
                      requests:
                          memory: '256Mi'
                          cpu: '250m'
                      limits:
                          memory: '512Mi'
                          cpu: '500m'
                  livenessProbe:
                      httpGet:
                          path: /health
                          port: 8080
                      initialDelaySeconds: 30
                      periodSeconds: 10
                  readinessProbe:
                      httpGet:
                          path: /ready
                          port: 8080
                      initialDelaySeconds: 5
                      periodSeconds: 5
                  securityContext:
                      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                      capabilities:
                          drop:
                              - ALL
```

[standards/application/container/STD-APP-CNT-001-container-deployment.md#network-policy]

#### Network Policy

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
    name: example-app-netpol
    namespace: example-namespace
spec:
    podSelector:
        matchLabels:
            app: example-app
    policyTypes:
        - Ingress
        - Egress
    ingress:
        - from:
              - namespaceSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        name: ingress-nginx
          ports:
              - protocol: TCP
                port: 8080
    egress:
        - to:
              - namespaceSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        name: database
          ports:
              - protocol: TCP
                port: 5432
        - to: [] # Allow DNS
          ports:
              - protocol: UDP
                port: 53
```

[standards/application/container/STD-APP-CNT-001-container-deployment.md#horizontal-pod-autoscaler]

#### Horizontal Pod Autoscaler

```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
    name: example-app-hpa
spec:
    scaleTargetRef:
        apiVersion: apps/v1
        kind: Deployment
        name: example-app
    minReplicas: 3
    maxReplicas: 20
    metrics:
        - type: Resource
          resource:
              name: cpu
              target:
                  type: Utilization
                  averageUtilization: 70
        - type: Resource
          resource:
              name: memory
              target:
                  type: Utilization
                  averageUtilization: 80
    behavior:
        scaleUp:
            stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
            policies:
                - type: Percent
                  value: 100
                  periodSeconds: 15
        scaleDown:
            stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
            policies:
                - type: Percent
                  value: 50
                  periodSeconds: 60
```

[standards/application/container/STD-APP-CNT-001-container-deployment.md#ingress-configuration]

#### Ingress Configuration

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
    name: example-app-ingress
    annotations:
        kubernetes.io/ingress.class: 'nginx'
        cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: 'letsencrypt-prod'
        nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: 'true'
        nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/force-ssl-redirect: 'true'
spec:
    tls:
        - hosts:
              - api.example.com
          secretName: example-app-tls
    rules:
        - host: api.example.com
          http:
              paths:
                  - path: /
                    pathType: Prefix
                    backend:
                        service:
                            name: example-app-service
                            port:
                                number: 80
```

[standards/application/container/STD-APP-CNT-001-container-deployment.md#cicd-pipeline-configuration]

#### CI/CD Pipeline Configuration

```yaml
# GitHub Actions example
name: Container Build and Deploy
on:
    push:
        branches: [main]

jobs:
    build:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4

            - name: Build Docker image
              run: |
                  docker build -t ${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }} .

            - name: Security scan
              run: |
                  docker run --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
                    aquasec/trivy image ${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }}

            - name: Push to registry
              run: |
                  echo ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }} | docker login -u ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_USERNAME }} --password-stdin
                  docker push ${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }}

            - name: Deploy to Kubernetes
              run: |
                  kubectl set image deployment/example-app app=${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }}
```

### 5.1 Automated Testing

Container testing should be integrated into CI/CD pipeline:

```bash
# Security scanning
trivy image --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL your-image:tag

# Configuration validation
kubeval deployment.yaml

# Policy validation
conftest test --policy security-policies deployment.yaml

# Load testing
kubectl run load-test --image=loadimpact/k6 --rm -it --restart=Never \
  -- run --vus 50 --duration 30s https://your-app.com/load-test.js
```
